item.title: [ 8 Maps ] Lingshan-Guangxi V 3.1
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 3
My English is not good, so I have to use a translation software. Please forgive me. -------------------------------------------- Plot Introduction ------------------------------------------------- When the zombie epidemic swept the world, the ancient city of Lingshan in southern China was also not spared. Under the overwhelming attack of the zombie tide, various areas in the suburbs successively fell. In such a critical moment, to have a chance of survival, one must venture to the evacuation point - Liufeng Mountain. The road to the evacuation point is fraught with dangers. Survivors must take up weapons and use their unwavering will to break through the siege! --------------------------------------------- Author's Note ------------------------------------------------ Thank you for subscribing! This is my first official campaign map. It took nearly two years from conception to completion. In the early development stage, a test version map was released, but the response was not satisfactory. The map design problems were very serious. After the test version, the entire test version process was reset for a year, and I refreshed the entire test version process and supplemented the subsequent levels. The new version of the map is more exquisite than the test version, with more mechanisms and a longer process. If you encounter any problems during gameplay, you can come to me for feedback. I will do my best to solve them. --------------------------------------------- Map Features ------------------------------------------------ * A large number of Chinese-style elements made by self-made textures * A large number of self-built solid-built models * Maps with a lot of effort spent on shaping * Some items can be picked up * Except for a few routes that use original scenes, the rest are all taken from real-life Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region's Lingshan City's Lingcheng * 8 chapters with all self-made levels --------------------------------------------- Map Construction Code ------------------------------------------------ M1_LS_FSL_LFSWJ M2_LS_FJL_LFSWJ M3_LS_ZSXML_LFSWJ M4_LS_XML_LFSWJ M6_LS_RMGC_LFSWJ M7_LS_HXQ_LFSWJ M8_LS_LFSJQ_LFSWJ M9_LS_LFSJQ_CXF_LFSWJ

item.title: [ 6 Maps ] NIGHTMARE HOUSE 2 UNOFFICIAL PORT
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
Nightmare House 2 is an acclaimed psychological horror campaign adapted for Left 4 Dead 2. You wake up inside a mysterious, eerie psychiatric hospital, guided by an unknown voice that knows you only as "Patient 42." Fight your way through dark corridors and face constant jump scares in an atmosphere of pure terror, where the line between reality and nightmare blurs.

item.title: [ Mod ] GTA V Speeding Car Ambience
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 1
If you have played GTA V for more then atleast 50-100 hours, you 100% know that quite often you'll hear the sound of a speeding car in the distance, and I decided to add it into l4d because I think it fits the creepy atmosphere of l4d honestly, that's my opinion, what you most likely didn't know is the sound in GTA actually changes depending on where you are on the map, so if your in the city it'll sound loud and kinda muffled fsr, and out north towards paleto bay it sounds quite quieter and more clear, and I made the loud and muffled one play in maps that are more of a big city that are more likely to be closer to where a speeding car would be, and maps that are more of a smalltown play the quiet and clear one, lemme be more specific: Loud & Muffled: The Passing C1-C2 Hard Rain No Mercy Crash Course Dead Air Quiet & Clear: Dead Center The Passing C3 Dark Carnival Swamp Fever The Parish Cold Stream Death Toll Blood Harvest The Sacrifice The Last Stand You also may notice that on Hard Rain the sound is a bit louder then usual, Especially if you muted the sound of the storm, but I adjusted the volumes to fit the ambience so it's not too quiet, And if you think I should change something lemme know in a comment and I'll let you know Note: You'll still here the audio play even if you get my add-on that mutes ambience, I recommend leaving ambience unmuted
